verses.he: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לְצֵ֥את בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בַּיֹּ֣ום הַזֶּ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.ar: فِي ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلثَّالِثِ بَعْدَ خُرُوجِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ، فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ جَاءُوا إِلَى بَرِّيَّةِ سِينَاءَ.
verses.en: In the third month after the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.kjv: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they [into] the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.web: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.he: וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵרְפִידִ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיִּֽחַן־שָׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נֶ֥גֶד הָהָֽר׃
verses.ar: ٱرْتَحَلُوا مِنْ رَفِيدِيمَ وَجَاءُوا إِلَى بَرِّيَّةِ سِينَاءَ فَنَزَلُوا فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ. هُنَاكَ نَزَلَ إِسْرَائِيلُ مُقَابِلَ ٱلْجَبَلِ.
verses.en: And when they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mount.
verses.kjv: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come [to] the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
verses.web: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

verses.he: וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה עָלָ֖ה אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ מִן־הָהָ֣ר לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לְבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתַגֵּ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مُوسَى فَصَعِدَ إِلَى ٱللهِ. فَنَادَاهُ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلْجَبَلِ قَائِلًا: «هَكَذَا تَقُولُ لِبَيْتِ يَعْقُوبَ، وَتُخْبِرُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ:
verses.en: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying: 'Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
verses.kjv: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
verses.web: Moses went up to God, and Yahweh called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

verses.he: אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְמִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ עַל־כַּנְפֵ֣י נְשָׁרִ֔ים וָאָבִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.ar: أَنْتُمْ رَأَيْتُمْ مَا صَنَعْتُ بِٱلْمِصْرِيِّينَ. وَأَنَا حَمَلْتُكُمْ عَلَى أَجْنِحَةِ ٱلنُّسُورِ وَجِئْتُ بِكُمْ إِلَيَّ.
verses.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto Myself.
verses.kjv: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and [how] I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.web: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

verses.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤ועַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּקֹלִ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֑י וִהְיִ֨יתֶם לִ֤י סְגֻלָּה֙ מִכָּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כִּי־לִ֖י כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: فَٱلْآنَ إِنْ سَمِعْتُمْ لِصَوْتِي، وَحَفِظْتُمْ عَهْدِي تَكُونُونَ لِي خَاصَّةً مِنْ بَيْنِ جَمِيعِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ. فَإِنَّ لِي كُلَّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: Now therefore, if ye will hearken unto My voice indeed, and keep My covenant, then ye shall be Mine own treasure from among all peoples; for all the earth is Mine;
verses.kjv: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth [is] mine:
verses.web: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

verses.he: וְאַתֶּ֧ם תִּהְיוּ־לִ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְגֹ֣וי קָדֹ֑ושׁ אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَأَنْتُمْ تَكُونُونَ لِي مَمْلَكَةَ كَهَنَةٍ وَأُمَّةً مُقَدَّسَةً. هَذِهِ هِيَ ٱلْكَلِمَاتُ ٱلَّتِي تُكَلِّمُ بِهَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ».
verses.en: and ye shall be unto Me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.'
verses.kjv: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These [are] the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
verses.web: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֖א לְזִקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَجَاءَ مُوسَى وَدَعَا شُيُوخَ ٱلشَّعْبِ وَوَضَعَ قُدَّامَهُمْ كُلَّ هَذِهِ ٱلْكَلِمَاتِ ٱلَّتِي أَوْصَاهُ بِهَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
verses.web: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.

verses.he: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ כָל־הָעָ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַיָּ֧שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ جَمِيعُ ٱلشَّعْبِ مَعًا وَقَالُوا: «كُلُّ مَا تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ نَفْعَلُ». فَرَدَّ مُوسَى كَلَامَ ٱلشَّعْبِ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And all the people answered together, and said: 'All that the LORD hath spoken we will do.' And Moses reported the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.web: All the people answered together, and said, “All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to Yahweh.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י בָּ֣א אֵלֶיךָ֮ בְּעַ֣ב הֶֽעָנָן֒ בַּעֲב֞וּר יִשְׁמַ֤ע הָעָם֙ בְּדַבְּרִ֣י עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־בְּךָ֖ יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ לְעֹולָ֑ם וַיַּגֵּ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِمُوسَى: «هَا أَنَا آتٍ إِلَيْكَ فِي ظَلَامِ ٱلسَّحَابِ لِكَيْ يَسْمَعَ ٱلشَّعْبُ حِينَمَا أَتَكَلَّمُ مَعَكَ، فَيُؤْمِنُوا بِكَ أَيْضًا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ». وَأَخْبَرَ مُوسَى ٱلرَّبَّ بِكَلَامِ ٱلشَّعْبِ.
verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses: 'Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and may also believe thee for ever.' And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ם הַיֹּ֖ום וּמָחָ֑ר וְכִבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِمُوسَى: «ٱذْهَبْ إِلَى ٱلشَّعْبِ وَقَدِّسْهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَغَدًا، وَلْيَغْسِلُوا ثِيَابَهُمْ،
verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses: 'Go unto the people, and sanctify them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their garments,
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

verses.he: וְהָי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לַיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כִּ֣י ׀ בַּיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י יֵרֵ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־הָעָ֖ם עַל־הַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.ar: وَيَكُونُوا مُسْتَعِدِّينَ لِلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ. لِأَنَّهُ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ يَنْزِلُ ٱلرَّبُّ أَمَامَ عْيُونِ جَمِيعِ ٱلشَّعْبِ عَلَى جَبَلِ سِينَاءَ.
verses.en: and be ready against the third day; for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.kjv: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.web: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

verses.he: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ֤ אֶת־הָעָם֙ סָבִ֣יב לֵאמֹ֔ר הִשָּׁמְר֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם עֲלֹ֥ות בָּהָ֖ר וּנְגֹ֣עַ בְּקָצֵ֑הוּ כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהָ֖ר מֹ֥ות יוּמָֽת׃
verses.ar: وَتُقِيمُ لِلشَّعْبِ حُدُودًا مِنْ كُلِّ نَاحِيَةٍ، قَائِلًا: ٱحْتَرِزُوا مِنْ أَنْ تَصْعَدُوا إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ أَوْ تَمَسُّوا طَرَفَهُ. كُلُّ مَنْ يَمَسُّ ٱلْجَبَلَ يُقْتَلُ قَتْلًا.
verses.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying: Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it; whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death;
verses.kjv: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, [that ye] go [not] up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.web: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

verses.he: לֹא־תִגַּ֨ע בֹּ֜ו יָ֗ד כִּֽי־סָקֹ֤ול יִסָּקֵל֙ אֹו־יָרֹ֣ה יִיָּרֶ֔ה אִם־בְּהֵמָ֥ה אִם־אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יִחְיֶ֑ה בִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הַיֹּבֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה יַעֲל֥וּ בָהָֽר׃
verses.ar: لَا تَمَسُّهُ يَدٌ بَلْ يُرْجَمُ رَجْمًا أَوْ يُرْمَى رَمْيًا. بَهِيمَةً كَانَ أَمْ إِنْسَانًا لَا يَعِيشُ. أَمَّا عِنْدَ صَوْتِ ٱلْبُوقِ فَهُمْ يَصْعَدُونَ إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ».
verses.en: no hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live; when the ram's horn soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.'
verses.kjv: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether [it be] beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.web: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

verses.he: וַיֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִן־הָהָ֖ר אֶל־הָעָ֑ם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וַֽיְכַבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَٱنْحَدَرَ مُوسَى مِنَ ٱلْجَبَلِ إِلَى ٱلشَّعْبِ، وَقَدَّسَ ٱلشَّعْبَ وَغَسَلُوا ثِيَابَهُمْ.
verses.en: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their garments.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.web: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם הֱי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים אַֽל־תִּגְּשׁ֖וּ אֶל־אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِلشَّعْبِ: «كُونُوا مُسْتَعِدِّينَ لِلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ. لَا تَقْرُبُوا ٱمْرَأَةً».
verses.en: And he said unto the people: 'Be ready against the third day; come not near a woman.'
verses.kjv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at [your] wives.
verses.web: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

verses.he: וַיְהִי֩ בַיֹּ֨ום הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיֹ֣ת הַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיְהִי֩ קֹלֹ֨ת וּבְרָקִ֜ים וְעָנָ֤ן כָּבֵד֙ עַל־הָהָ֔ר וְקֹ֥ל שֹׁפָ֖ר חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.ar: وَحَدَثَ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّالِثِ لَمَّا كَانَ ٱلصَّبَاحُ أَنَّهُ صَارَتْ رُعُودٌ وَبُرُوقٌ وَسَحَابٌ ثَقِيلٌ عَلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ، وَصَوْتُ بُوقٍ شَدِيدٌ جِدًّا. فَٱرْتَعَدَ كُلُّ ٱلشَّعْبِ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ.
verses.en: And it came to pass on the third day, when it was morning, that there were thunders and lightnings and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of a horn exceeding loud; and all the people that were in the camp trembled.
verses.kjv: ¶ And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that [was] in the camp trembled.
verses.web: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

verses.he: וַיֹּוצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הָעָ֛ם לִקְרַ֥את הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּתַחְתִּ֥ית הָהָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَأَخْرَجَ مُوسَى ٱلشَّعْبَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ لِمُلَاقَاةِ ٱللهِ، فَوَقَفُوا فِي أَسْفَلِ ٱلْجَبَلِ.
verses.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.kjv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.web: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

verses.he: וְהַ֤ר סִינַי֙ עָשַׁ֣ן כֻּלֹּ֔ו מִ֠פְּנֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרַ֥ד עָלָ֛יו יְהוָ֖ה בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַיַּ֤עַל עֲשָׁנֹו֙ כְּעֶ֣שֶׁן הַכִּבְשָׁ֔ן וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־הָהָ֖ר מְאֹֽד׃
verses.ar: وَكَانَ جَبَلُ سِينَاءَ كُلُّهُ يُدَخِّنُ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلنَّارِ، وَصَعِدَ دُخَانُهُ كَدُخَانِ ٱلْأَتُونِ، وَٱرْتَجَفَ كُلُّ ٱلْجَبَلِ جِدًّا.
verses.en: Now mount Sinai was altogether on smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire; and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.kjv: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.web: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

verses.he: וַיְהִי֙ קֹ֣ול הַשֹּׁופָ֔ר הֹולֵ֖ךְ וְחָזֵ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יַעֲנֶ֥נּוּ בְקֹֽול׃
verses.ar: فَكَانَ صَوْتُ ٱلْبُوقِ يَزْدَادُ ٱشْتِدَادًا جِدًّا، وَمُوسَى يَتَكَلَّمُ وَٱللهُ يُجِيبُهُ بِصَوْتٍ.
verses.en: And when the voice of the horn waxed louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.kjv: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.web: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

verses.he: וַיֵּ֧רֶד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקְרָ֨א יְהוָ֧ה לְמֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָ֖ר וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: وَنَزَلَ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَى جَبَلِ سِينَاءَ، إِلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْجَبَلِ، وَدَعَا ٱللهُ مُوسَى إِلَى رَأْسِ ٱلْجَبَلِ. فَصَعِدَ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, to the top of the mount; and the LORD called Moses to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.kjv: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses [up] to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.web: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה רֵ֖ד הָעֵ֣ד בָּעָ֑ם פֶּן־יֶהֶרְס֤וּ אֶל־יְהוָה֙ לִרְאֹ֔ות וְנָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ רָֽב׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِمُوسَى: «ٱنْحَدِرْ حَذِّرِ ٱلشَّعْبَ لِئَلَّا يَقْتَحِمُوا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ لِيَنْظُرُوا، فَيَسْقُطَ مِنْهُمْ كَثِيرُونَ.
verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses: 'Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.

verses.he: וְגַ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים הַנִּגָּשִׁ֥ים אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה יִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ פֶּן־יִפְרֹ֥ץ בָּהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَلْيَتَقَدَّسْ أَيْضًا ٱلْكَهَنَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْتَرِبُونَ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ لِئَلَّا يَبْطِشَ بِهِمِ ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.en: And let the priests also, that come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.'
verses.kjv: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
verses.web: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל הָעָ֔ם לַעֲלֹ֖ת אֶל־הַ֣ר סִינָ֑י כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה הַעֵדֹ֤תָה בָּ֙נוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַגְבֵּ֥ל אֶת־הָהָ֖ר וְקִדַּשְׁתֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ مُوسَى لِلرَّبِّ: «لَا يَقْدِرُ ٱلشَّعْبُ أَنْ يَصْعَدَ إِلَى جَبَلِ سِينَاءَ، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ حَذَّرْتَنَا قَائِلًا: أَقِمْ حُدُودًا لِلْجَبَلِ وَقَدِّسْهُ».
verses.en: And Moses said unto the LORD: 'The people cannot come up to mount Sinai; for thou didst charge us, saying: Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.'
verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.web: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ לֶךְ־רֵ֔ד וְעָלִ֥יתָ אַתָּ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהָעָ֗ם אַל־יֽ͏ֶהֶרְס֛וּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה פֶּן־יִפְרָץ־בָּֽם׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ: «ٱذْهَبِ ٱنْحَدِرْ ثُمَّ ٱصْعَدْ أَنْتَ وَهَارُونُ مَعَكَ. وَأَمَّا ٱلْكَهَنَةُ وَٱلشَّعْبُ فَلَا يَقْتَحِمُوا لِيَصْعَدُوا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ لِئَلَّا يَبْطِشَ بِهِمْ».
verses.en: And the LORD said unto him: 'Go, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee; but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest He break forth upon them.'
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.web: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”

verses.he: וַיֵּ֥רֶד מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃ ס
verses.ar: فَٱنْحَدَرَ مُوسَى إِلَى ٱلشَّعْبِ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ.
verses.en: So Moses went down unto the people, and told them.
verses.kjv: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.web: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.
